scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.check: npm run check -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w web
